# Philippa Gordon

## Appearance

Philippa is a strikingly beautiful girl with brown eyes, a rose-red, crooked mouth, and a bewitching, dimpled smile. She has smooth hair and a warm, glowing complexion with brown tints that suit gold and yellow dresses. Although she considers herself short, she possesses a graceful, stylish figure.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c4 P40](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0040), [v3 c26 P1](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0001), [v3 c26 P3](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0003)_

## Personality

Philippa is a gay,irrepressible, and intensely charming girl who often appears frivolous and indecisive on the surface. She possesses a clever intellect, performing exceptionally well in her studies despite her giddy demeanor. Highly sought-after socially, she is open-hearted, generous, and completely free of envy or snobbery. Beneath her lighthearted, teasing manner lies a loyal, affectionate soul who deeply values true friendship and devotion.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 c26 P13](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0013), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c27 P20](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0020)_

## History

Philippa Gordon first met Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant in Old St. John's Cemetery during her Freshman year at Redmond College. Coming from a wealthy family in Bolingbroke, she quickly befriended them and brought them into her social circle. She was courted by numerous suitors, particularly two hometown admirers named Alec and Alonzo, whom she struggled to choose between due to her extreme indecisiveness. During her college years, Philippa moved into Patty's Place with Anne, Priscilla, Stella, and Aunt Jamesina. While vacationing at Prospect Point, she met Jonas Blake, a poor divinity student, and fell deeply in love with him. Overcoming her former desire for wealth and luxury, she accepted Jonas's proposal and committed herself to becoming a minister's wife. She graduated from Redmond with Honors in Mathematics alongside her friends.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c4 P50](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0050), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c10 P48](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0048), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c24 P8](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0008), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021), [v3 c27 P18](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0018), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_
